name: gh-tools
description: Local marketplace: the synology-nas control plugin plus the deep-integration-builder methodology used to create it.

plugins.name: synology-nas
plugins.description: Full control of a Synology DiskStation (DSM 7.x) — MCP server reaching all ~870 DSM Web APIs plus curated tools, a control skill, and workflow commands.

plugins.name: deep-integration-builder
plugins.description: Methodology skill + command for building comprehensive, deeply-tested control integrations (MCP + skill + workflows) for any system with an API. Captures the discover-first, generic+curated, live-verify, honest-gap-taxonomy, reverse-engineer-from-UI-traffic workflow.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: Full control of a self-hosted GitLab CE instance (verified on 19.0.0) — MCP server with generic REST+GraphQL passthrough reaching all ~170 API domains, ~35 curated tools (projects, repos, MRs, issues, CI/CD, runners, admin), a control skill, and workflow commands.

plugins.name: emby
plugins.description: Full control of an Emby media server (verified on 4.7.14.0) — MCP server with a generic passthrough reaching all ~484 REST operations (self-discovered from the live OpenAPI spec), ~30 curated tools (status, library & metadata, users & policies, sessions & remote playback control, transcoding analysis, scheduled tasks, plugins & catalog, collections, playlists, configuration), a control skill with official-docs references (configuration, troubleshooting, optimization, plugin management & development), and workflow commands.

plugins.name: romm
plugins.description: Full control of a RomM ROM-library server (verified on 5.0.0) — MCP server with a generic passthrough reaching all ~189 REST operations (self-discovered from the live OpenAPI spec), ~70 curated tools (platforms, ROM search & metadata matching, manuals/soundtracks/patches, screenshots, collections, users & fine-grained permissions, saves/states, firmware, tasks, feeds, exports, device pairing & sync, netplay, chunked uploads), a pollable Socket.IO scan trigger, a control skill, and workflow commands.

plugins.name: unifi-network
plugins.description: Full control of a Ubiquiti UniFi console (UniFi OS) — MCP server reaching every Network endpoint across the classic v1, modern v2, and UniFi OS host APIs, plus ~30 curated tools for health, devices, clients, wireless, firewall, port-forwarding, traffic rules, events and statistics, a control skill, and workflow commands. Tested against a UniFi Dream Router 7.

plugins.name: comfyui-control
plugins.description: Deep ComfyUI control v2 (built with deep-integration-builder, live-verified on ComfyUI 0.26.0): generation suite (txt2img/img2img/inpaint/upscale/LoRA/batch), LTX-Video + animated GIFs, HF/Civitai model management, PNG workflow remix, custom-node installs, websocket per-node progress, projection-mapping batch workflow (seamless palindrome GIF loops), full 46-route API passthrough, and a skill with per-model prompt engineering + a model encyclopedia.

plugins.name: opencode-control
plugins.description: Deep control of the OpenCode AI coding agent (anomalyco/sst opencode; live-verified on 1.18.3). Two connectors: the HTTP server (opencode serve) via a full 188-operation passthrough (self-discovered from the live OpenAPI /doc) plus ~30 curated tools (status, sessions, prompt, agents, commands, skills, models/providers, config, MCP, files/find, VCS, TUI control, events, server lifecycle), AND an ACP (Agent Client Protocol) connector that drives `opencode acp` over JSON-RPC/stdio to run prompts as an agent with no server needed. Plus on-disk authoring of agents/commands/skills and opencode.json patching, and a control skill covering configuration, optimization, and agent/workflow design.
